about: A04 shot list: a Snap it. spot (see episodes/A01-just-sign).

shots.name: a04cliff
shots.prompt: Very slow, very slight push-in, no zoom, no cuts. On a golden clifftop meadow a stylized 3D animated photographer crouches in the grass shooting a couple, while behind her a small white paper airplane flutters past on the wind and drifts toward the cliff edge. Just before it is lost, a soft ribbon of glowing pale lavender sparkle dust swoops in, catches the paper airplane and loops it gently around, landing it softly on her shoulder. She notices, reads it, gasps and smiles, and the couple laugh and wave. Expressive animated performance, smooth character animation, warm golden light on their faces, grass swaying in the wind. Same faces, same clothes, same place, nothing morphs. Feels playful and a little magical. Crisp, vivid colours and clear contrast throughout, no haze, no fog, no fade, no mist, no smoke.

shots.name: a04m1
shots.prompt: Continuous single take. The camera pulls back smoothly and quickly, up and away from the character, revealing the whole scene as a small cutaway diorama sitting on a pale lavender studio backdrop. Everyone stays exactly where they are, nobody walks, floats or grows. Only the camera moves. No cuts, no fades, no morphing, no dissolve.

shots.name: a04diorama
shots.prompt: Very slow, very slight push-in; the whole diorama stays in frame the entire time; no zoom, no cuts. On a small diorama of a golden clifftop meadow on a pale lavender backdrop, tiny stylized 3D animated characters stand in the swaying grass: the photographer raises her camera and the couple hug and laugh; a tiny paper airplane glides in a slow circle above them. The diorama does not change shape. Same faces, same clothes, nothing drifts. Clean pale backdrop throughout, crisp, no haze, no fog. Feels light and satisfied.
